hypothesis: Oil's retained multihorizon auction direction can be entered repeatedly without quota when a completed CL and matched MCL pullback crosses from the adverse side of each contract's causal Globex-session VWAP back into the retained direction. Raw-direction alignment identifies acceptance continuation; raw opposition or weakness identifies a failed-auction reclaim. This session inventory benchmark should produce frequency and expectancy together rather than patching a sparse turn engine.

profile.direction_owner: exact unchanged V18 DirectionalImpulse breadth engine retained trend state on completed 5m CL
profile.inventory_owner: separate cumulative HLC3-volume VWAP for CL and MCL, reset only at canonical Globex trading session or contract
profile.trigger: previous completed CL and MCL closes both adverse to their then-current session VWAP; current completed closes both reclaim the retained direction

branches.acceptance_continuation: raw direction equals retained trend state
branches.failed_auction_reclaim: raw direction is absent or opposes retained trend state

profile.projected_entry: next one-minute matched MCL open in the same contract and session outside maintenance
profile.neighbor_policy: none; no VWAP band, ATR distance, time window, volume threshold, or direction-engine mutation
